tool.name: nf-core lima
tool.description: lima - The PacBio Barcode Demultiplexer and Primer Remover
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ OUT_EXT=""
if [[ $ccs =~ bam\$ ]]; then OUT_EXT="bam" elif [[ $ccs =~ fasta\$ ]]; then OUT_EXT="fasta" elif [[ $ccs =~ fasta.gz\$ ]]; then OUT_EXT="fasta.gz" elif [[ $ccs =~ fastq\$ ]]; then OUT_EXT="fastq" elif [[ $ccs =~ fastq.gz\$ ]]; then OUT_EXT="fastq.gz" fi
lima \\ $ccs \\ $primers \\ $prefix.\$OUT_EXT \\ -j $task.cpus \\ $args
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": lima: \$( lima --version | head -n1 | sed 's/lima //g' | sed 's/ (.\\+//g' ) END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
<![CDATA[ **What it does**
lima - The PacBio Barcode Demultiplexer and Primer Remover
**nf-core Module**
This tool is automatically generated from nf-core modules repository.
Module: lima Container: ${ workflow.containerEngine ==
**More Information**
For more information about this tool, visit: https://github.com/nf-core/modules/tree/master/modules/nf-core/lima ]]>
